name: Rune of Resistance (3.5)
body:
Aura faint abjuration; CL 5th; Slot rune; Price 45,000 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This rune grants the bearer resistance 10 to two energy types chosen at the time that the rune is inscribed.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Inscribe Rune, resist energy; Cost 22,500 gp.
